generation.scope: Every ordinary positive fixed rank-fifteen window has a common four-center cut with a central monomial basis through degree nine at all starts. The ninth uncut and cut dimensions are 220 and 20. An upper bound of five for one odd-length character is enough: Walsh translations act transitively on the characters and preserve the zero-character center, so four open Grassmannian conditions intersect. A signed bivariate descent and eleven finite exceptional fibers verify the bound on the whole ordinary locus.

open_mathematics: Lift five-center quotient word multiplication through length eight to a free module over one central parameter. Use the quadratic residual relations on length-seven generators to propagate minors through thirteen, descend the exceptional signed pairs, and test all residual points. The whole ordinary rank-fifteen plane and general four-window coverage remain open.
